title: Find the number that appears once, and other numbers twice.
stepTitle: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
category: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
problemStatement: Every element appears twice except one. Find the single element.
intuition: x ^ x = 0 and x ^ 0 = x, so XOR-ing the whole array annihilates every pair and leaves the loner.

approaches.title: Better: frequency map
approaches.idea: Count occurrences, return the key with count 1.

approaches.title: Optimal: XOR fold
approaches.idea: Order does not matter — XOR is commutative and associative.
approaches.whyWorks: Pairs cancel regardless of position because XOR is commutative.

commonMistakes: Sorting first (O(n log n) for no reason)
patternRecognition: Pairs cancel -> XOR; triples do not cancel, use bit-count mod 3
